info.title: Fortuneness API
info.description: Server-authoritative contracts for the Fortuneness iPhone and iPad application.

get.description: Reports only process and PostgreSQL readiness. It never returns versions, URLs, credentials, or dependency errors.

200.description: The process is accepting traffic and PostgreSQL is reachable.

503.description: The process is draining or PostgreSQL is unavailable.

post.description: Verifies a fresh Sign in with Apple identity token and returns authoritative account bootstrap and rotating session tokens.

200.description: The Apple identity token was verified and an active session was issued.

400.description: The identity token request or advisory device context is malformed.

401.description: The token is invalid, stale, replayed, or issued for another client.

410.description: A stale retained identity points at an already purged account.

423.description: The account is pending deletion and no normal session was issued.

503.description: Apple identity verification or stable database state is unavailable.

get.description: Returns owned immutable readings in stable issuedAt/id descending order using a filter-bound opaque cursor.

200.description: One bounded page of owned readings.

400.description: The filters, range, limit, or opaque cursor are invalid or mismatched.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

get.description: Returns one owned immutable reading; another account is indistinguishable from absent.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

404.description: The reading is absent or belongs to another account.

get.description: Returns the canonical 78-card deck with owned discovery timestamps and orientation progress.

200.description: All 78 canonical cards and caller-owned discovery state.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

get.description: Returns one canonical card plus a stable opaque-cursor page of caller-owned readings for it.

200.description: The canonical card discovery state and one owned reading page.

400.description: The card key, limit, or opaque cursor is invalid or mismatched.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

404.description: The canonical card does not exist.

patch.description: Idempotently marks one owned immutable reading viewed after all reveal copy is rendered and reachable.

200.description: The owned reading with its stable viewed timestamp.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

404.description: The reading is absent or belongs to another account.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Atomically consumes one refresh token and returns exactly one replacement. Exact same-key retries may replay the encrypted receipt for up to 120 seconds.

200.description: The refresh token was rotated or an exact replay was returned.

400.description: The request or idempotency key is malformed.

401.description: The refresh token or session family is invalid.

409.description: The idempotency key was reused for different input.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

423.description: The account entered deletion pending before refresh could commit.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Revokes the current refresh-token family after authoritative session checks.

204.description: The current session family was revoked.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account was purged before logout could commit.

423.description: The account entered deletion pending before logout could commit.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Returns authoritative account preferences and bootstrap context.

200.description: The active account and current bootstrap context.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account was purged before bootstrap could commit.

get.description: Returns server-clock allowance, subscription, monotonic period, time-zone, pack-credit, and resumable-reading state.

200.description: The active account fortune state and any owned unviewed reading.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Atomically selects server-owned content and consumes exactly one allowance after authoritative locks and keyed request validation.

200.description: An exact same-key issuance replay returned the original draw.

201.description: A new immutable fortune was issued and saved.

400.description: The intention or idempotency key is malformed.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

409.description: The key was reused for other input, an unviewed reading is pending, or no allowance remains.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Content is incomplete or stable database state could not be acquired after bounded retries.

get.description: Returns the allowlisted product IDs, server-owned benefit copy, grace-period policy, and the current server-issued purchase token. Prices remain StoreKit-owned.

200.description: The allowlisted catalog and the caller purchase token.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Verifies one StoreKit signed transaction and applies its benefit exactly once through the atomic application service. Duplicate accepted delivery is normal success with appliedNow false.

200.description: The transaction was verified and durably applied, already applied, delivered to its recorded other owner, or terminally closed without benefit.

400.description: The JWS is unverified or the product is not allowlisted.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

409.description: No owner is identifiable; the transaction is quarantined unfinished.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: A retryable lock or database failure occurred; retry without finishing.

post.description: Independently verifies and idempotently applies up to 100 signed current or unfinished transactions enumerated by the client.

200.description: One independent disposition per submitted transaction.

400.description: The batch shape or an item exceeds the documented bounds.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Returns the caller-owned normalized subscription entitlement, nonnegative spendable pack balance, and commerce-review lock state.

200.description: The caller-owned entitlement and pack balance.

401.description: The access token or authoritative session is no longer active.

410.description: The account has already been purged.

503.description: Stable database state is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Receives App Store Server Notifications V2. The outer and nested JWS are verified and the envelope is stored durably before acknowledgement; processing happens asynchronously.

200.description: The verified envelope was durably persisted.

400.description: The envelope is malformed or fails verification.

503.description: Durable persistence is temporarily unavailable; Apple should retry.

post.description: Receives signed Sign in with Apple account-change notifications. Consent revocation invalidates every application session; permanent Apple Account deletion queues immediate account purge.
post.summary: Receive Sign in with Apple account notifications

200.description: The verified account event was applied or idempotently acknowledged.

400.description: The envelope is malformed or fails Apple signature validation.

503.description: Apple signing keys or durable persistence are temporarily unavailable.
